image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The surrounding environment includes coarse sand, small pebbles, and reddish algae/seaweed.
